meta.title: Jeeva Art School | Drawing & Painting Classes in Bengaluru
meta.description: Learn acrylic, watercolour, Tanjore, oil, pencil and charcoal with Jeeva Kumari. Coaching for Karnataka Secondary Board Drawing Exams in Bengaluru since 2005.

footer.note: Drawing and painting classes in Bengaluru. All ages welcome.

sections.title: Jeeva Art School
sections.subtitle: Drawing & painting classes in Bengaluru
sections.body: Learn at your own pace with personal guidance — from first sketches to exam-ready work.

sections.title: A little background
sections.body: I am Jeeva Kumari, an art teacher since 2005. I teach painting, drawing and sketching to students of all ages, with patient, hands-on guidance. I also coach for drawing exams conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board.
sections.quote: You do not need natural talent to master art. With guidance and practice, anyone can excel.

sections.title: Mediums taught in the studio
sections.subtitle: Pick a path that interests you — or try several. Classes are tailored to your level.

classes.title: Acrylic

classes.title: Oil painting
classes.description: Rich tones, blending and landscape studies.

classes.title: Pencil & charcoal
classes.description: Portraits, still life and tonal shading.

classes.title: Board exam coaching
classes.description: Six-month programme for Karnataka drawing exams.

sections.title: Artwork For Sale
sections.body: Authentic, hand-painted visual art by master artist Jeeva and studio artists. Each piece is unique, crafted with traditional pigment and seasoned canvas, and includes custom framing and studio authentication.
